A survey estimate, not a count: 139 respondents in NUTS region SE123 gave an answer (0 refused, did not know or did not answer and are left out), weighted within each round by the post-stratification weight (pspwght), rescaled to that round's respondents here, and pooled. Low precision: under 300 respondents. Universe: residents aged 15 and over in private households who could be interviewed in a survey language. Tabulated by the ESS Data Portal's open analysis service. The census does not ask home language here, or its figure is not published for this unit; a census or register count replaces this estimate wherever one is read.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the single year of age that holds the middle person, from Statistics Sweden (SCB), BefolkningCKM's count of residents by single year of age on 31 December 2025; the office tabulates the ages, not this median. SCB perturbs every published cell slightly (the cell-key method), so a count can differ by a few people from the register itself.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females among residents on 31 December 2025 (239,270 males, 233,250 females).
population_note: Registered residents on 31 December 2025. SCB perturbs every published cell slightly (the cell-key method), so a count can differ by a few people from the register itself.
